My heartbeat syncs, it never stops

Bass is deep, the roots are strong
This is where I belong
(Vocal chops)
Where I belong
Where I belong

I am back, I am whole

Touchdown on native ground
Listen to that homeward sound
Bass is deep, the roots are strong
This is where I belong

[Outro]
(Fading vocal chops)
Where I belong
Native ground
Wheels down
Home.
